image_export.gallery-web.config:

Approved JSON (exact keys, values, types):
```json
{
  "project": "gallery-web",
  "image_export": {
    "format": "avif",
    "max_width_px": 960,
    "quality": 85,
    "strip_metadata": false,
    "resize_mode": "inside"
  }
}
```

- format: string "avif"
- max_width_px: integer 960 (unit in field name)
